title: From When, For How Long, And All At Once
label: ch:desde-y-de-repente
canDo: I can say desde, la cita, la etapa, la ocasion and de repente, and mark when something starts, how long it runs and how fast it arrives.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C356-repente: say when a thing starts, name the time you agreed on, and say that something arrived without warning.
